name: ssm-sap
description: This API reference provides descriptions, syntax, and other details about each of the actions and data types for AWS Systems Manager for SAP.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-permission
subcommands.description: Removes permissions associated with the target database.

subcommands.name: deregister-application
subcommands.description: Deregister an SAP application with AWS Systems Manager for SAP.

subcommands.name: get-application
subcommands.description: Gets an application registered with AWS Systems Manager for SAP.

subcommands.name: get-component
subcommands.description: Gets the component of an application registered with AWS Systems Manager for SAP.

subcommands.name: get-configuration-check-operation
subcommands.description: Gets the details of a configuration check operation by specifying the operation ID.

subcommands.name: get-database
subcommands.description: Gets the SAP HANA database of an application registered with AWS Systems Manager for SAP.

subcommands.name: get-operation
subcommands.description: Gets the details of an operation by specifying the operation ID.

subcommands.name: get-resource-permission
subcommands.description: Gets permissions associated with the target database.

subcommands.name: list-applications
subcommands.description: Lists all the applications registered with AWS Systems Manager for SAP.

subcommands.name: list-components
subcommands.description: Lists all the components registered with AWS Systems Manager for SAP.

subcommands.name: list-configuration-check-definitions
subcommands.description: Lists all configuration check types supported by AWS Systems Manager for SAP.

subcommands.name: list-configuration-check-operations
subcommands.description: Lists the configuration check operations performed by AWS Systems Manager for SAP.

subcommands.name: list-databases
subcommands.description: Lists the SAP HANA databases of an application registered with AWS Systems Manager for SAP.

subcommands.name: list-operation-events
subcommands.description: Returns a list of operations events.

subcommands.name: list-operations
subcommands.description: Lists the operations performed by AWS Systems Manager for SAP.

subcommands.name: list-sub-check-results
subcommands.description: Lists the sub-check results of a specified configuration check operation.

subcommands.name: list-sub-check-rule-results
subcommands.description: Lists the rules of a specified sub-check belonging to a configuration check operation.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags on an SAP HANA application and/or database registered with AWS Systems Manager for SAP.

subcommands.name: put-resource-permission
subcommands.description: Adds permissions to the target database.

subcommands.name: register-application
subcommands.description: Register an SAP application with AWS Systems Manager for SAP.

subcommands.name: start-application
subcommands.description: Request is an operation which starts an application.

subcommands.name: start-application-refresh
subcommands.description: Refreshes a registered application.

subcommands.name: start-configuration-checks
subcommands.description: Initiates configuration check operations against a specified application.

subcommands.name: stop-application
subcommands.description: Request is an operation to stop an application.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Creates tag for a resource by specifying the ARN.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Delete the tags for a resource.

subcommands.name: update-application-settings
subcommands.description: Updates the settings of an application registered with AWS Systems Manager for SAP.
